newsitem.title: UK: UKOOA names James May new director general.
newsitem.headline: UKOOA names James May new director general.

text.p: The UK Offshore Operators Association (UKOOA) on Thursday named James May as its new director general, replacing Harold Hughes who retires at the end of February.

May, a lawyer, is currently director general of the British Retail Consortium. UKOOA said May has "a wealth of experience in the operation of industry representation bodies and once worked at the National Farmers Union.
UKOOA represents the interests of 33 oil companies exploring for and producing hydrocarbons in UK waters.
"My experience in the running of industry associations will be very relevant, and I am looking forward to involvement in this highly successful industry," May said in a statement.
